name: DeskcommCRM
description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.
one_liner: A customer-relationship system you run yourself where an AI assistant answers, qualifies and sells to customers over WhatsApp, instead of a human sales rep replying to every chat.
buyer: A small e-commerce or services business in Brazil that currently handles every sale over WhatsApp by hand and wants to stop losing leads overnight or during busy hours.
business_use_cases: A boutique clothing store connects it to their WhatsApp Business number so an AI agent answers 'is this in stock' questions and books sizes 24/7.
A dental clinic uses it to qualify appointment requests and automatically confirm bookings without staff manually replying to every WhatsApp message.
A digital marketing agency resells hosted instances to their small-business clients as a 'WhatsApp sales assistant' add-on service.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you hosted deployment (on a partner VPS) for non-technical shop owners who can't self-host.
Charge a setup fee to configure the WhatsApp connection, AI prompts, and sales flows for a specific business.

steal_this: Package the HostGator one-command install into a weekend 'WhatsApp AI sales assistant in a box' service targeted at Brazilian small retailers, charging a flat setup fee plus monthly hosting.
